records.name: Cal Holdfast
records.biography_en: Cal Holdfast serves with Shield Detail, a riot unit detail assigned to HyperNorm disturbances. The short transparent shield with thick ivory frame is familiar enough to hold onto when a routine encounter becomes a surprise.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Cal Holdfast looks stubbornly braced even when the briefing has run out of useful instructions.
